title: Getting Started
description: Set up your first Hot Chocolate GraphQL server in .NET Core.
longDescription: This module introduces GraphQL and Hot Chocolate. You will understand how GraphQL compares to REST, set up a .NET project, write your first query and mutation types, and organize a production-ready project structure.
whatYouLearn: What GraphQL is and why it is useful
How Hot Chocolate fits into the .NET ecosystem
How to create and configure a GraphQL server
How to structure a Hot Chocolate project
